import os,sys,time
secret=os.environ["NODESTEER_PARAM_secret"]
mode=os.environ["NODESTEER_PARAM_mode"]
limit=int(os.environ["NODESTEER_LOG_LIMIT"])
half=len(secret)//2
if mode=="prefix-cancel":
 sys.stdout.write(secret[:half]);sys.stdout.flush();time.sleep(120)
elif mode=="prefix-timeout":
 sys.stdout.write(secret[:half]);sys.stdout.flush();time.sleep(20)
elif mode=="split-streams":
 sys.stdout.write(secret[:half]);sys.stdout.flush();time.sleep(0.5)
 sys.stderr.write(secret[half:]);sys.stderr.flush();time.sleep(0.5)
elif mode=="limit-mid-secret":
 sys.stdout.write("L"*(limit-half)+secret[:half]);sys.stdout.flush();time.sleep(0.3)
 sys.stdout.write(secret[half:]+"\nLIMIT-TAIL");sys.stdout.flush()
 sys.stderr.write("LIMIT-ERR-TAIL");sys.stderr.flush()
